_note: Hero 5 (docs/plans/design/rebuild-heroes.md section 8c; rebuild-phase8-heroes.md 8d-3). HP, DEF, CRIT, speed, and Shadowstep's mana are the design's; ATK 16 (the design's 24) and a 1s Knife with +10 attack speed bring her base team within 10 points of the old three's in Act 1 (30% against 22%; at 24 it won 53%: build-tuning.md, section 4). The mana gains and Shadowstep's 3-hex reach are first numbers. Hidden is her own Stealth: it ends as her next basic attack fires, and that attack is from Stealth.
name: Tamsin Gloamstep
title: the knife

basic_attack.name: Knife
basic_attack.text: A quick stab at the enemy in front of her. She goes for the weakest enemy within 3 hexes, else the nearest.

signature.name: Shadowstep
signature.text: She slips behind the weakest enemy within 3 hexes and is hidden until she next strikes.

passives.name: From the Dark
passives.text: Her attacks from Stealth always crit.
